biography:
As a former collegiate and international athlete, I transitioned from a career in real estate—where I specialized in office, land, and industrial brokerage—to my current role at Equinix. For the past nine years, I’ve been helping some of the world’s most prominent companies with site selection and crafting their digital transformation strategies across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

While my background in real estate provided a strong foundation in client service and negotiation, my work at Equinix has allowed me to focus on the cutting edge of digital infrastructure. I’ve consistently been a top performer, earning Presidents Club recognition, and I’ve taken on multiple leadership roles along the way. My experiences in sports, real estate, and tech have equipped me with a unique perspective and a strong emphasis on teamwork, strategy, and delivering exceptional results.
